notes.title: Alpha 2.0 Patch notes
notes.content:
Alpha 2.0 patch notes

New content:
God powers:
-Each god has their own unique god power now.
-Gain magical power to cast the unique ultimate ability by last hitting enemies, capturing towers and you will also regenerate it over time.
-Added god selection and mirror into the menu.
Dark realm
-Fight against Erebos, the first shadow in his dark realm.
-Beat him in all 6 levels to unlock him as an avatar and gain loot.
-if you exit the realm before beating him, your progress will reset.
Scaling bot:
-Added scaling bot into the game, as name suggests it scales with the players skill level.
-Bots MMR score increases if you beat him and decreases if you lose.
-Always uses random deck, so you might get lucky and beat him, and has huge variance.
-Sends best score to leaderboard so you can compete with other people even in singleplayer and you can follow your progress ingame.

Changes and new features:
-Revamped shooting ranges look with new textures and models.
-Added some stone tablets behind menu texts to make them easier to see.
-Added dark realm menu.
-Added dark realm arena.
-Removed tutorial portal, to make room for realms and scaling bot, it can be still accessed trough controller menu wheel.
-Added new music and lots of new sound effects.
-Improved and added a lot of particle effects.
-Added animations for evil god avatar when he's not controlled by a human.
-Improved inverse kinematics that move player characters according to players movements.
-Added option to start tutorial in the menu wheel.
-Added option to skip tutorial in the menu wheel.
-Added introtuction to god powers inside tutorial.
-Improved the visuals of the arena.
-Added new towers and base structures.
-Added new spawn effects for units, changed depending on the god you use.
-Added new healthbars for towers and better ammunition indicators.
-Made fame bottle breakable.
-New anvil effects.
-Added spells to bots arsenal and introduced cooldown for high level bots, so that with their superior resource generation they cannot just destroy everything with spells.
-Added cancel functionality to pvp and friend matchmaking portal, you can cancel search by clicking portal during search.
-Added timeout to match confirmation, if you wont confirm within 20 seconds the match is cancelled.
-Displaying current PVP rank and world ladder position on top of the pvp portal.
-Added trophies, get better trophies by increasing your MMR.
-Improved matchmaking confirmations, pingcheck and migrations.
-Disabled controller rumble and particle effects after successfull craft to make it clearer when its done.
-Hiding unit healthbars when they get spawned, enabling after taking damage.
-War cry attackspeed bonus multiplier lowered from 2 to 1.5
-Minotaur attack interval lowered from 2 to 4


Bug fixes:
-fixed missing arrow rain visuals.
-fixed anvil handle particle effects to correspond correctly to the handle being used.
-added missing arrows to quiver.
-added textures to some places where they were missing.
-fixed a bug that could happen and make lootbox disappear before all loot was taken.
-fixed some object snapping bugs in menu.

notes.title: Alpha 1.04b hotfix
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug that would prevent some users from accessing higher level bots.
-Fixed a bug that arrow could disappear in shooting range.
-Fixed trebuchet rolling hitchance twice.
-Adjusted rain of arrows indicators to match better with actual area of effect.

notes.title: Alpha 1.04 update
notes.content:
-Added some spells for some bots, bots will learn deck management and better spell usage later.
-Fixed particle effects on anvil handles to correspond to correct handle pressed.
-Disabled particle effects and controller rumble when craft is succesful to make it clearer when its complete.
-Made miniatures kinematic when held to avoid rumbling collisions when pressed against the table.
-Fixed some lag issues when placing locked miniatures to anvil.
-Made great performance improvements in menu, this should provide multiple times the current fps.
-Added proper material to face off platform.
-Improved plague doctor cloud effect performance.
-Fixed some spelling errors on some unit tooltips.

notes.title: Alpha 1.03b Hotfix
notes.content:
BugFixes:
-Fixed a softlock bug that could occur if you shut the game in tutorial after opening the tutorial lootbox but not taking the loot.
-Fixed a disappearing arrow bug which could occur in gameplay when you release an arrow and disable bow during the period your next arrow should appear.

notes.title: Alpha 1.03 update
notes.content:
General:
-Fixed unit name updating bug on arena.
-Made various bot improvements.
-Added new botlevel.
-Fixed unit animations on new unitwheel.
-Fixed freeze spell not reliably freezing.
-Enabled famebottle interaction with left controller.

Balance:
-Reduced powershot damage multiplier.
-Reduced power shot effect multiplier.
-Reduced Beebox cost from 9 to 8.
-Reduced minotaur charge damage multiplier against towers.

notes.title: Alpha 1.02b Hotfix
notes.content:
-fixed orb buff visual indexes.
-added filler to empty orb slots
-modified face off on the start of each match so that you spawn in the center, the placeholder visuals regarding the face off will be updated in next patch.

notes.title: Alpha 1.01 Update
notes.content:
-Added lock symbols to locked miniatures.
-Made locked miniature color a bit darker to make them stand out from the background.
-Fixed arrow disappearance bug during gameplay.
-Adjusted bot fame rewards on higher levels.

notes.title: Patch Notes 19th of July
notes.content:
Patch notes 19th of July

New bows added: 
-trueshot bow 
-multishot bow 
-powershot bow

New quivers added: 
-Freezing quiver.
-Explosive quiver.

New effects added:
-Fireworks when game ends.
-Archer arrow hit effect.
-Digger dirt particles when moving.
-Wizard cloud, lightning and area indicator.

New features:
-Steam achievements added for game.
-Randomize only units that have not been selected to loadout.
-Controller linerenderer enabled on menu only when pointing at teleport zone.
-1 second trigger holding time when pointing at portals to prevent accidental teleportation.
-New duration indicators for timed units.
-Music can be muted and the setting saves when entering menu.
-Orbs wont break when you hold them anymore.
-New table visuals added.
-New menu graphical assets added.
-New cool drinkable fame as reward from lootbox.
-Halo effect for player characters.
-New textures for player characters.
-Moved unit order on the table a bit, the tutorial loadout and default units stay the same.

Balance:
-Freeze spell duration increased to 10 seconds.
-Orbs of time now increase time for timed units, 1 second for each tier.
-Beebox duration increased to 48 seconds (9 bees summoned on lifetime).
-Deploying units behind the main base is no longer possible.

Other changes:
-Added sounds for spells.
-New bot portal selection visuals.
-Fixed the almost never expiring beebox.
-Disabled pvp portal and friend matchmaking portal when not connected to server.
-Fixed bot portal selection bug.
-Deleted playerprogress, made new system for data.
-Fame reward now should save even if you quit the game before claiming the rewards.
-Units should now snap to slots from close range.
-Units can no longer be deployed within eachother with the new spawning system.
-Replaced old tutorial deployment instructions with updated ones.

notes.title: Patch notes 13th of July
notes.content:
Patch notes 13th of July

-Fixed various errors happening from bee projectile on pvp scenario.
-Added some failsafes to prevent errors occuring from the mentioned issue in the future.
-Fixed Beebox timer not being updated corretly on clients.

Balance Changes:
-bee attack interval reduced from 2 to 3. 
-beebox cost increased to 9. 
-tent duration reduced from 45 to 40 seconds. 
-dragon resourcecost reduced from 3 to 2. 
-Beebox famecost to unlock increased to 150.

notes.title: Patch notes 12th of July
notes.content:
Patch notes 12th of July

Features:
-Added new match confirmation window on pvp.
-Returning to default state if other player declines.
-Added friend matchmaking(challenging your friends)
note: friendpvp and pvp only works if you are on the same server.
-Added option to switch server on menuwheel.
-Added new UI elements like new unitwheel and new menuwheel visuals.
-Added new power orb models and textures.
-Added new "swipe" unit selection option to make unitselection easier on all platforms. (you can toggle the old system on if you want to use that)
-Units now get deployed on trigger release rather than press down.
-Disabled unit deployment with touchpad clicking
-Added new healthbars for towers, and replaced ammo bars with individual ammo indicators.
-Added new player character models to game, which track the movements of the player.
-Rounded lasthit rewards to avoid very long floats.
-Reduced lasthit rewards to be divided by the amount unit of summoned at once.
-Timed units have new time indicator circles to replace the time bars.
-Added timescaling to rewards, you get betterrewards on longer game.
-Added small reward even if you lose a pvp game.
-ELO points now get scaled by the match duration in addition to the rank difference between players.
-New tooltips for units.
-Showing deck units on hand below unitwheel in order which they will pop up.
-Added some different bow and quiver rewards.
-Fixed error that would occur when grabbing items from other hand.

Balance changes:
-Reduced Bee box duration from 45 to 40seconds.
-Reduced Ballista range from 20 to 10.
-Increased amount of archers deployed at once to 2.

This was a quick patch to get feedback on the new controls, we'll be changing those and implementing new fixes and improvements soon.

notes.title: Patch notes 2nd of July
notes.content:
Patch notes 2nd of July

-Increased resource generation by 50%
-Changed the fame cap from 100 to 999

notes.title: Patch notes 29th of June
notes.content:
Patch notes 29th of June

-Implemented new win & lose banners.
-Timed units lose now time when attacked.
-Ranking system added, each player has a elo rank that changes when you win/lose games vs players.
-Placeholder Inverse kinematic bodies for players added, so you can watch the opponent move in his tower.
-Selected units are now saved between matches for convenience.
-Added new loading screen when game starts.
-Deleted all player progress from players, this is to make the system scaleable so we wont have to do it again.
-Some new character sounds
-Changed power orbs to grant greater of % and flat values to units. they now grant 0.5 flat or 2% for each tier. This change does not affect speed buffs or spells.

notes.title: Patch notes 25th of June
notes.content:
Patch notes 25th of June

-Added multispawning indicator and centered it (the thing that indicates where the unit gets spawned), it now shows the amount of units.
-Fixed a bug where unit faceoff would display wrong units.
-Added network info box next to pvp portal that shows online players, ongoing matches, your region and ping to servers.
-Added a feature to reduce multiplayer delay on slower networks.
-Fixed power orb multiplying exploit/bug.
-Gamebalance of units has been greatly shifted, this includes resource costs, health, damage and speed of almost every unit.
-Added new duration indicators for timed units.
-Added new Bar indicators in menu describing the attribute levels of units.
